title: jig UI design tokens
description: jig's token table in the W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) JSON format: groups nest, a token is an object with $value. Only color tokens are read. The jig extension adds the theme values and the names by which the code refers to the token. A file listed in ui.tokens, or the stdout of ui.tokens.command.

oneOf.description: A group of tokens and groups

$value.description: A color string (#RGB, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, rgb(), rgba()), a DTCG color object with hex, or an alias {group.token}

themes.description: Theme name (as in ui.themes) to the value in that theme; a color string or an alias

refs.description: The names by which code refers to the token (e.g. a variable name or a dotted key); jig finds them by a literal search
